name: retail-pos
description: Offline Windows restaurant POS: Electron + React UI + Spring Boot server

scripts.dev:desktop: wait-on -t 180000 http-get://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health http-get://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w ui && cd server && ./gradlew test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w ui && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm run typecheck -w admin-ui
scripts.dist:till: npm run dist:prepare && npm run dist:till -w desktop
scripts.dist:admin: npm run dist:prepare && npm run dist:admin -w desktop
scripts.dist: npm run dist:prepare && npm run dist:till -w desktop && npm run dist:admin -w desktop
